title: Negative Expected Drift Does Not Imply a Unique Attractor at 1: Eliahou Windows, Rhin Linear Forms in Logarithms, and the Collatz Teaming Lemma in Lean 4

description: 23-module Lean 4 formalization and companion study of inverse-residue teaming for the 3n+1 map, M92 block-map Diophantine identities, Eliahou/Steiner/Rhin cycle bounds, and the Frohman Model Mean observation (μ_F = log(3/4) < 0) showing via 3n-1 that negative expected logarithmic drift coexists with multiple periodic attractors.
